definition.burnside_identity: number of ordered-pair orbits is |G|^-1 sum_g Fix_targets(g)^2
definition.effective_group: faithful order-1920 action on the sixteen frozen labels
definition.joint_law_transport: the complete C90 joint-survival, mixed-moment, and covariance payload is constant on each ordered-pair orbit
definition.ordered_pair_action: g.(i,j)=(g.i,g.j) under the diagonal induced target action
definition.transpose: (i,j) maps to (j,i), inducing an involution on pair orbits
